settings.title: How CBD Works in Your Body

settings.text:
Your body has a built-in regulatory network called the endocannabinoid system, or ECS. It plays a central role in maintaining balance across nearly every major physiological process — including sleep, mood, inflammation, pain perception, and immune response.

The ECS operates through two primary receptors: CB1 receptors, concentrated in the brain and central nervous system, and CB2 receptors, found primarily in immune tissues and peripheral organs. Your body naturally produces its own cannabinoids — called endocannabinoids — that bind to these receptors to keep systems in balance.

When the ECS is functioning well, the body maintains homeostasis: a stable internal environment despite external stressors. When it's disrupted, the result can be inflammation, poor sleep, anxiety, and chronic pain.

CBD — cannabidiol — is a phytocannabinoid derived from hemp. Unlike THC, CBD does not bind directly to CB1 or CB2 receptors and produces no psychoactive effects. Instead, it works indirectly: CBD inhibits the enzyme that breaks down your body's own endocannabinoids, allowing them to remain active longer and support ECS balance more effectively.

CBD also interacts with non-cannabinoid receptors involved in pain signaling, inflammation, and mood — including serotonin and vanilloid receptors. All NextEvo products are 100% THC-free, non-psychoactive, and derived from U.S.-grown hemp.

The majority of CBD products on the market are oil-based. The problem is that CBD oil and water don't mix — and your body is approximately 60% water. When oil-based CBD is ingested, it must pass through the digestive system and liver before any CBD reaches the bloodstream. This process, known as first-pass metabolism, eliminates a significant portion of the CBD before it can take effect. With most oil-based products, as little as 10% of the CBD you consume actually reaches your bloodstream.

SmartSorb™ is NextEvo's patented water-soluble CBD technology, developed by former Johnson & Johnson executives with 30+ patents in drug delivery and formulation.

Instead of suspending CBD in oil, SmartSorb™ converts CBD into a water-soluble emulsion — microscopic particles small enough to pass directly through the intestinal wall and into the bloodstream without significant first-pass metabolism.

This isn't a marketing claim. It's the output of deep pharmaceutical expertise, innovative product development and extensive clinical research.
